ElderProfile.title: ElderProfile
ElderProfile.description: An elder user's EasyTap Ride profile, emergency contact, and authorized caregiver Gmail list.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

ownerName.description: Display name shown on the elder's profile.

ownerEmail.description: Lowercase Gmail address of the profile owner.

sosName.description: Name of the designated Emergency (SOS) contact.

sosPhone.description: Phone number of the SOS contact.

assistEmails.description: Bounded list (max 10) of lowercase Gmail addresses authorized to assist this profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

SavedPlace.title: SavedPlace
SavedPlace.description: A one-tap saved destination card belonging to an elder profile.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent profile owner.

assistEmails.description: Synced copy (max 10) of parent profile's authorized caregiver emails.

name.description: Short display label on the destination card.

shortcode.description: Optional Plus Code or location shortcode.

addedBy.description: Name or email of caregiver if added on behalf of elder.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the place was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the place was last updated.

AssistMember.title: AssistMember
AssistMember.description: A family caregiver authorized by Gmail to manage an elder profile.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent profile owner.

assistEmails.description: Synced copy (max 10) of parent profile's authorized caregiver emails.

isSos.description: Whether this caregiver is marked as the active SOS contact.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the caregiver was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the caregiver entry was last updated.

/profiles/{profileId}.description: Elder profile root documents, keyed by owner UID.

/profiles/{profileId}/places/{placeId}.description: Saved one-tap destination cards for an elder profile.

/profiles/{profileId}/assists/{assistId}.description: Authorized family caregivers linked to an elder profile.
